THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image and enter an upload limit in KB. The tool searches JPEG or WebP quality settings and, if allowed, smaller dimensions. It only offers a download when the encoded file fits the limit. Here, 1 KB means 1,024 bytes.

Try this example

For a portal with a 100 KB photo limit, set the target to 100 and compare the result before submitting. Check the required format and dimensions too.

How your data is handled ↗How to fit a photo under an upload limit ↗

Good to know

Will it create exactly the requested file size?

No. It aims for at or below the limit. Very small limits may need reduced dimensions, and image detail may be lost. If it cannot reach the limit within its search range, it says so instead of offering an oversized file.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
